interface.signature: def sumK(root: TreeNode, K: int) -> int:

preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.
K must be an integer within the range [-10^9, 10^9].

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for path in all_paths(root) if sum(path) == K)
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of all downward paths in the tree (starting and ending at any node) whose sum of node values equals K.
The return value is a non-negative integer representing the count of valid paths, bounded by the maximum possible paths in a tree of size N (10^5).
The return value is computed modulo 10^9 + 7 to handle large numbers.
